AMBIGUITY_MAX.source: the midpoint of the span: aligned when the best rival costs at least a quarter of the ink

AMBIGUITY_SPAN.source: a place that loses half of the ink the component explains is no rival to it

ANCHOR.source: a split fills its region: its outer children reach its edges

ASPECT_MAX.source: the same run: aspect p99 3.9 among good fits, all radical forms squeezed one way (木 in 桐 0.25/0.93, 心 in 忠 1.0/0.31)

CANDIDATES.source: enough for the joint fit to prefer a spanning placement to a dense spot

COARSE_STEP.source: half a stroke of Noto Sans JP 500 at EM = 100

COARSE_TOLERANCE.source: the first pass looks with a looser eye than its step

FIRST_TOLERANCE.source: a looser eye for a step of 8 em

INNER_FROM.source: the wrapping stroke and its gap

INSET.source: the wall of the enclosure: about one stroke

LIFT_MARGIN.source: half a stroke: the white next to a stroke is where chance would put it

OFF_COST.source: a placement is worth keeping only when most of it lands on ink

PRECISION_MIN.source: the p1 of precision among direct placements (0.84): below it a placement lies visibly off the ink

RECONSIDER.source: a second sweep settles what the first one moved

SCALE_MAX.source: the same run: variants and components drawn small on their own reach 1.24–1.29 (冫 in 翠, ⺝ in 育); a fit at a limit is approximate (at-scale-limit)

SCALE_MIN.source: full run of the split fit, fits with lift ≥ 0.9 and precision ≥ 0.95: characters sx 0.20–1.08, sy 0.18–1.05 (p0.5–p99.5), a radical form down to 0.23 (木 in 械); below 0.15 a component is a dense spot, not itself

SEAM_COST.source: v1 glyph/metrics seam: 偏 and 旁 part where the ink is thinnest; in 換 a cut through 扌 let 冂 take its stroke

SEEDS.source: enough to hold every distinct place a component could take in its region

SLACK.source: Noto Sans JP 500: a component overhangs its nominal region by a stroke or less

SPLITS.source: the unequal splits of the benchmark (氵|林 about 0.3|0.7); nine cuts, every 7.5% of the side

SPLITS_DEEP.source: two levels down and deeper: three cuts

SPLITS_NESTED.source: a split inside a component: five cuts, every 15%

SPLIT_MARGIN.source: Noto Sans JP 500: neighbouring components interlock by about a stroke

SPLIT_MARGIN_STROKE.source: 厂 = ⿱一丿: the 丿 begins at the end of the 一

SPLIT_MIN_PART.source: a middle component takes at least a stroke and its gaps

STROKE_WEIGHT.source: a stroke glyph fits almost any ink: in 作, opened into strokes, a stroke took the ink of 亻 at full worth

TOLERANCE.source: one 1 em cell and its diagonal (v1 relate reads with one cell of tolerance)

WRAPPER_MIN.source: the wrapper spans the character (門 in 闇, 囗 in 囚, 辶 in 辻)

face: align-1 holds for this face only: another font, package version, weight or measure is a new table (align-2 …)

grid.inkCell: a 1 em cell is ink when at least half of it is (v1 raster pixels, alpha > 127)

render.antialiasing: canvas 2D fillText, the browser's default (greyscale) antialiasing, software rendering (--disable-gpu)

rules.confidence: lift × (1 − ambiguity); ambiguity = 1 − (what the joint fit loses when the component moves to its best rival place ÷ what it explains) ÷ AMBIGUITY_SPAN, the rival searched in its region with its own and its siblings' ink taken; a subtree takes its least sure part. It says how sure the geometry is, not whether the component exists
rules.existence: structure-1 says what exists; a row says where and how well, never whether. A poor fit is approximate, not absent.
rules.glyph: a leaf is placed as the glyph of its own code point in the reading face (氵 as 氵, 囗 as 囗); a code point the face does not have, or an unencoded component, is unavailable: no other character stands in for it
rules.joint: top down: a node tries each way its operator cuts its region, fits each child in its part and keeps its CANDIDATES best combinations of its children's best; value = the whole's ink explained, each cell worth what its strongest claimant makes it (a stroke STROKE_WEIGHT, else 1), − OFF_COST × ink off − OVERLAP_COST × ink two leaves both claim (not under ⿻) − SEAM_COST × the ink each cut runs through; a combination that breaks its operator (order along a split, the enclosed inside its wrapper, the anchors) only when none keeps it
rules.order: entries by code point in 64 shards (code point mod 64); rows in the tree's path order (pre-order)
rules.reconsider: then RECONSIDER sweeps: each leaf searched again with the ink its siblings explain counted against it, in its region and (when every part around it is placed) its parent's whole region; a new place only when the joint value rises; then each leaf nudged while the others hold still
rules.regions: each child is searched only in the region its operator gives it inside its parent's region. ⿰⿲ side by side and ⿱⿳ stacked: the parent is cut at each of SPLITS (a component one level down: SPLITS_NESTED; deeper: SPLITS_DEEP), each child in its part widened by SPLIT_MARGIN across a cut (a stroke: SPLIT_MARGIN_STROKE); ⿴ surround and inside, ⿵ open below, ⿶ open above, ⿷ open right, ⿸ from the upper left, ⿹ from the upper right, ⿺ from the lower left (a wrapper that is one glyph spans WRAPPER_MIN of the parent, the enclosed child keeps INSET / INNER_FROM away from the wrapping sides); ⿻ overlay. The character's own children reach its edges (ANCHOR)
rules.residual: the whole's ink minus the component grown by one cell (v1 relate), in 8-connected pieces; a piece under SLIVER of the whole is a misfit's sliver; each piece's side is where its centroid lies against the component's box; interleaved: a row or column of pieces with the component's ink between each two
rules.search: per leaf and region: every box on a grid of twice COARSE_STEP (every fourth ink cell, FIRST_TOLERANCE), the best climbed at COARSE_STEP (COARSE_TOLERANCE), the SEEDS best climbed at 2, 1 and 0.5 em with every ink cell (TOLERANCE); score = placed ink on the whole's ink − OFF_COST × placed ink off it
rules.status: aligned: precision ≥ PRECISION_MIN, lift ≥ LIFT_MIN, no scale at its limit, ambiguity ≤ AMBIGUITY_MAX, its operator kept, not a stroke, no sibling left unplaced; otherwise approximate, with every reason; unavailable: no glyph of its own in the face, unencoded, or no room in its region within the scale limits (a subtree: no part placed)
rules.subtree: a node that is a subtree has no glyph of its own: its box is the union of its placed parts; its status follows from theirs
rules.transform: x' = x·sx + dx, y' = y·sy + dy, from the component's em space (its ink centre at the origin) into the whole's (v1 measure, EM = 100); sx and sy apart
rules.unexplainedInRegion: an unavailable leaf: the whole's ink in its region that no placed component explains (ink, not a stand-in glyph)
